name: Acid Splash

summary.upcast: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, 4d6 at level 17

description: You hurl a bubble of acid at 1 creature within 60 ft, or at 2 creatures within 5 ft of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.

name: Alarm
description: Ward a door, window or area up to a 20 ft cube within 30 ft for 8 hours. Whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters it, you are alerted. You can name creatures that do not set it off.
Choose the alert type when casting. Mental: a ping in your mind, which wakes you, if you are within 1 mile. Audible: a hand-bell sound for 10 seconds, heard within 60 ft. Ritual.

name: Animal Friendship
description: Pick a beast you can see within 30 ft; it must be able to see and hear you. If its Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours.
The charm ends if you or your companions harm it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 lets you affect 1 more beast.

name: Armor of Agathys

summary.upcast: +5 temporary hit points and +5 cold damage per slot level above 1

description: You gain 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour, wrapped in spectral frost. While any remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points and 5 cold damage.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Dark tentacles erupt from you in a 10 ft radius. Each creature in the area makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
A creature that fails also cannot take reactions until its next turn.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Bane
description: Up to 3 creatures you can see within 30 ft each make a Charisma save. For the duration (concentration, 1 minute), each one that fails rolls a d4 whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw, and lowers that result by the number rolled.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Blade Ward
description: Until the end of your next turn, weapon attacks deal you only half their bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage (you have resistance to those types).

name: Bless
description: Up to 3 creatures within 30 ft are blessed for 1 minute (concentration). Whenever a target attacks or saves, it can roll a d4 and add it to the result.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Burning Hands
description: Flames fan out from your hands in a 15 ft cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the cone that nobody is wearing or carrying catch fire.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Charm Person
description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. Failing, it is charmed for 1 hour, and sees you as a friendly acquaintance. Harming it ends the charm.
It knows afterwards that you magically influenced it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

name: Chill Touch

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: A ghostly hand grips a creature within 120 ft: make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 necrotic damage, and the target cannot heal until your next turn starts. An undead target you hit also attacks you at disadvantage through the end of your next turn.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Chromatic Orb
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within 90 ft. Pick the orb's type first: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder. A hit deals 3d8 damage of that type.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Color Spray

m.text: a pinch of powder or sand coloured red, yellow and blue

description: Roll 6d10 for a pool of hit points. Creatures in a 15 ft cone are affected in order of lowest current hit points first, skipping unconscious creatures and those that cannot see.
Each creature whose hit points fit within what is left of the pool is blinded until the spell ends (1 round), and its hit points are subtracted from the pool.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d10 to the roll.

name: Command
description: Give a one-word order to a creature within 60 ft that you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or carries out the command on its next turn. Nothing happens if it is undead, does not understand your language, or the command would directly harm it.

Sample words: Approach (comes toward you, stopping within 5 ft), Drop (lets go of what it holds), Flee (moves away fast), Grovel (falls prone), Halt (no move, no actions). The DM rules on other words; if the target cannot obey, the spell ends.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

name: Compelled Duel
description: A creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save. If it fails, for 1 minute (concentration) it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. To move more than 30 ft from you it needs a Wisdom save; success lifts the limit that turn.

The spell ends if you attack another creature or cast a spell at a hostile creature besides the target, if an ally damages the target or aims a harmful spell at it, or if you finish a turn over 30 ft away.

name: Comprehend Languages

m.text: a pinch of soot and salt

description: For 1 hour, you understand any spoken language you hear. If you touch a surface bearing writing, you can read it too, taking about 1 minute per page.
It does not reveal hidden meaning, secret codes or non-written symbols. Ritual.

name: Create or Destroy Water

m.text: a drop of water for creating, or a few grains of sand for destroying

description: Pick one effect, aimed within 30 ft:
• Create: fills an open container with up to 10 gallons of fresh water, or rain soaks a 30 ft cube and douses flames there.
• Destroy: removes up to 10 gallons of water from an open container, or burns off fog in a 30 ft cube.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 10 gallons, or 5 ft to the cube's side.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Dancing Lights

m.text: a bit of phosphorus, wychwood or a glowworm

description: Up to 4 torch-like lights hover at points within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), or you can fuse them into one glowing humanoid form. Each gives dim light in a 10 ft radius.
Use a bonus action to shift any of them up to 60 ft. Keep them within 20 ft of one another; any that ends up over 120 ft from you vanishes.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense whether aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead are within 30 ft, and where. You also sense places or objects within 30 ft that are consecrated or desecrated.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it.

name: Detect Magic
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense magic within 30 ft. As an action you can see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object there, and learn its school of magic.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 ft, learning what kind each one is and where.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.

name: Disguise Self
description: For 1 hour, or until you dismiss it as an action, you and your gear look different. You can seem 1 ft taller or shorter, thin, fat or in between, but must keep the same basic limb arrangement.
It fails touch inspection: a fake hat would let hands pass through. A creature can use an action to inspect you and make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: You whisper a horrible tune only one creature within 60 ft can hear. It makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d6 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
On a failure it must also use its reaction to flee as far as it can by its speed, avoiding dangerous ground. A deafened creature is immune.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Divine Favor
description: For 1 minute (concentration), each time you hit with a weapon attack you add 1d4 radiant damage.

name: Druidcraft
description: Choose one minor nature trick within 30 ft:
• Forecast the next 24 hours of weather.
• Force a flower to open or a bud to sprout at once.
• Produce an instant, harmless sensory effect that fits in a 5 ft cube: drifting leaves, a gust, an animal call, a whiff of scent.
• Ignite or douse a candle, torch or small campfire.

name: Eldritch Blast

summary.upcast: 1d10 at level 5, 1d10 at level 11, 1d10 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 force damage.
At level 5 you fire 2 beams, at level 11 3 beams and at level 17 4 beams. Each beam needs its own attack roll and may go at the same or different targets.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: Your next weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) also conjures thorny vines around the target. It makes a Strength save (advantage if Large or bigger) or is restrained.

Each of its turns begins with 1d6 piercing damage while the vines hold. The target, or anyone able to touch it, can use an action and beat your spell save DC with a Strength check to free it, ending the vines.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Entangle
description: Thick weeds and vines sprout across a 20 ft square within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), making it difficult terrain. Anyone inside when you cast it makes a Strength save or is restrained.
To break free, a restrained creature spends an action and beats your spell save DC with a Strength check. The growth fades when the spell ends.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration), you may Dash as a bonus action on every turn, starting with the turn you cast this.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Pick a 20 ft cube within 60 ft. Objects in it glow blue, green or violet (your choice); each creature in it makes a Dexterity save and, on a failure, glows too. This lasts up to 1 minute (concentration).
Glowing things shed dim light for 10 ft. Attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them, and invisibility does not hide them.

name: False Life

m.text: a little alcohol or distilled spirits

description: You gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points.

name: Feather Fall

cast.trigger: when you or a creature within 60 ft falls

m.text: a small feather or piece of down

description: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 ft falls. Up to 5 falling creatures within range drop at only 60 ft per round for 1 minute. One that lands before then takes no falling damage and lands on its feet, and the spell ends for it.

name: Find Familiar

m.text: 10 gp of charcoal, incense and herbs, burned

description: Casting takes 1 hour. A spirit takes a tiny animal form you pick (bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider or weasel) within 10 ft. It is a celestial, fey or fiend, obeys you, rolls its own initiative and cannot attack.
Within 100 ft you speak to it telepathically. As an action you can see and hear through it until your next turn begins, blind and deaf to your own surroundings.

It can deliver your touch-range spells using its reaction. At 0 hit points it vanishes; recasting brings it back. Dismiss it to a pocket dimension or call it back within 30 ft. Casting again changes its form. 1 familiar only.

name: Fire Bolt

summary.upcast: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 fire damage. A loose, unworn object that can burn catches fire.
higherLevels: Damage rises to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11 and 4d10 at level 17.

name: Fireball

m.text: Pellet of bat guano and sulfur

description: A streak flies to a point you pick within 150 ft and blooms into a 20 ft radius burst of flame. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
The blast wraps around corners and sets loose flammable objects alight.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You raise a 20 ft radius sphere of fog centred on a point within 120 ft, for up to 1 hour (concentration). It spreads around corners and heavily obscures the area. A strong wind (10 mph or more) disperses it in 1 minute.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 20 ft to the radius.

name: Friends

m.text: a little makeup applied to your face as you cast

description: For up to 1 minute (concentration) you have advantage on Charisma checks aimed at one creature of your choice that is not hostile to you.
When the spell ends, that creature realizes you used magic on it and turns hostile toward you. A violent one may attack you; others may seek revenge in other ways, at the DM's discretion.

name: Goodberry
description: Up to 10 berries appear in your hand, magical for 24 hours. A creature can use its action to eat one: it restores 1 hit point and feeds the creature for a day.
Berries not eaten within 24 hours lose their magic.

name: Grease

m.text: a bit of pork rind or butter

description: Slick grease covers a 10 ft square on the ground within 60 ft for 1 minute, making it difficult terrain. Anyone standing in it when you cast it makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.
A creature that enters or ends its turn there makes the same save.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the result to one ability check of its choice. The spell then ends.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the glow.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Hail of Thorns

summary.upcast: +1d10 per slot level above 1, up to 6d10

description: Your next ranged weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) also bursts into thorns. The target and every creature within 5 ft of it make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.
The spell ends once that happens.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1, to a maximum of 6d10.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature you can see within 60 ft regains 1d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d4 for each slot level above 1.

name: Hellish Rebuke

cast.trigger: when a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you

description: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you. Flames wreath it, and it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch gains courage for 1 minute (concentration). It cannot be frightened, and each of its turns begins with temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier.
When the spell ends, it loses any temporary hit points this spell gave it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Hex

summary.upcast: slots 3-4: concentration up to 8 hours; slots 5+: up to 24 hours

m.text: the petrified eye of a newt

description: Curse one creature within 90 ft you can see for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each time you hit it with an attack you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability score you choose when you cast the spell.
If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the curse to a new creature within range as a bonus action.
higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.

name: Hold Person
description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed. It repeats the save when each of its own turns finishes; a success frees it and ends the spell on it.
higherLevels: A higher slot holds 1 extra humanoid per level above 2; targets must stand within 30 ft of one another.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a creature you can see within 90 ft as your quarry for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each hit you land on it with a weapon deals 1d6 extra damage, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it.
If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the mark to a new creature within range as a bonus action.
higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.

name: Identify

m.text: a pearl worth 100 gp and an owl feather

description: Over 1 minute, touch an object throughout the casting. A magic item reveals what it does and how to use it, whether it needs attunement, and its charges. You also learn which spells, if any, are affecting it, what they are, and which spell made it, if one did.
Touch a creature instead to learn which spells currently affect it. Ritual.

name: Illusory Script
description: Over 1 minute you write on parchment, paper or similar material, laying an illusion on it that lasts 10 days. You and anyone you name see it as normal writing with the meaning you intended. Everyone else sees an unreadable, unknown script.
Alternatively, others can see a wholly different message, in another hand and a language you know.
Dispelling it destroys both the script and the illusion. A creature with truesight can read the hidden message. Ritual.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: You strike a creature you touch with a melee spell attack. If it hits, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

name: Jump
description: You touch a creature. For 1 minute its jump distance is 3 times normal.

name: Light
description: One object up to 10 ft across glows for 1 hour: bright light 20 ft out, dim light another 20 ft, in any colour you pick. Something opaque placed over it hides the glow. Casting the spell again, or dismissing it as an action, ends it.
If a hostile creature carries the object, it can make a Dexterity save to avoid the spell.

name: Longstrider
description: A creature you touch gains +10 ft of speed for 1 hour.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Mage Armor
description: Touch a willing creature that wears no armor. For 8 hours its base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor or you dismiss it as an action.

name: Mage Hand
description: A floating hand appears at a point within 30 ft and stays for 1 minute. It disappears if you dismiss it, recast the spell, or move more than 30 ft from it.

Use an action to move it 30 ft and have it handle something: open an unlocked door, take an item from or put one into an open container, or pour out a vial. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or lift over 10 lb.

name: Magic Missile
description: You fire 3 darts of force at creatures you choose within 120 ft that you can see. Each dart strikes automatically for 1d4+1 force damage. You can send every dart at one target or split them across several.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 dart.

name: Mending
description: Touch a single break or rip no longer than 1 ft in any direction, such as a snapped chain link, torn cloak or leaking wineskin. It mends with no trace of damage.
It can physically fix a magic item or construct, but cannot bring back any magic the object lost.

name: Message

m.text: a short piece of copper wire

description: Point at a creature within 120 ft and whisper. Only it hears you, and it can whisper an answer only you hear.

It works through solid objects if you know the target is behind the barrier and are familiar with it. Silence, 1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood blocks it. It bends around corners and through openings.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You make either a sound or a still image of an object, lasting 1 minute. A sound can be a whisper to a scream and can shift in volume or tone. An image fits in a 5 ft cube and has no sound, smell or light of its own.

Anyone who uses an action to examine it can make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it, and it then looks faint to them. Touching it also exposes it. Casting the spell again replaces the old one.

name: Misty Step
description: In a puff of silver mist you teleport up to 30 ft to an empty space you can see. It costs only a bonus action and needs just a spoken word, no gestures.

name: Poison Spray

summary.upcast: 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, 4d12 at level 17

description: You puff noxious gas at a creature within 10 ft. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage.
Damage rises to 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11 and 4d12 at level 17.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Pick one minor trick within 10 ft:
• Harmless sensory effect: sparks, a gust, soft notes, an odd smell.
• Light or snuff a candle, torch or small campfire.
• Clean or soil an object up to 1 cubic ft.
• Chill, warm or flavour 1 cubic ft of non-living material for 1 hour.
• Make a colour, mark or symbol appear on a surface for 1 hour.
• Make a hand-sized trinket or illusory image until your next turn ends.
Up to 3 timed effects at once; dismiss one as an action.

name: Produce Flame

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: A flame appears in your palm and lasts 10 minutes. It does not hurt you, lights a 10 ft radius brightly and a further 10 ft dimly.
You can hurl it at a creature within 30 ft as a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 fire damage. Throwing the flame ends the spell.
higherLevels: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Protection from Evil and Good

m.text: holy water, or powdered silver and iron (used up)

description: A willing creature you touch gains a ward for up to 10 minutes (concentration) against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead. Those creatures attack it at disadvantage and cannot possess it or charm or frighten it.
If it is already under such an effect, it gets a new save against it with advantage.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: All non-magical food and drink in a 5 ft radius sphere centred on a point within 10 ft is cleansed of poison and disease. Ritual.

name: Ray of Frost

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 1d8 cold damage and cuts the target's speed by 10 ft until your next turn begins.
higherLevels: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 2d8 poison damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Resistance
description: You touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add it to one saving throw of its choice, before or after rolling the save. The spell then ends.

name: Sacred Flame

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Radiance falls on a creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage. Cover gives it no bonus to this save.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Sanctuary
description: Bonus action. Ward a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute. Anyone who targets it with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save, or pick a new target or lose the attack or spell.
Area effects are not stopped. The ward ends if the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell, or damages another creature.

name: Searing Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and sets the target alight.

Each time one of its turns starts while it burns, the target makes a Constitution save. A failure deals it 1d6 fire damage; a success ends the spell with no damage. The fire also goes out, ending the spell, if the target or someone within 5 ft spends an action to smother it, or if something douses it, such as plunging under water.
higherLevels: The extra damage on the hit rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Shield

cast.trigger: when you're hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile

description: Until your next turn begins, you gain +5 AC, which also applies to the attack that triggered the spell. For the same time you take no harm from magic missile.

name: Shield of Faith

m.text: a small parchment with holy text written on it

description: A creature within 60 ft is surrounded by a shimmering field and gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes (concentration).

name: Shillelagh

m.text: mistletoe, shamrock leaf, a club or quarterstaff

description: A club or quarterstaff you hold turns magical for 1 minute. Your melee attacks with it, for hit and damage, rely on your spellcasting ability rather than Strength, and it deals a d8. Recasting the spell or dropping the weapon ends it.

name: Shocking Grasp

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch, with advantage if it wears metal armor. A hit deals 1d8 lightning damage, and the target cannot take reactions until its next turn begins.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Silent Image
description: You create an image of an object, creature or effect within 60 ft, no larger than a 15 ft cube. It makes no sound, smell or other sensation, and lasts up to 10 minutes (concentration).

As an action you can move it anywhere in range, and its look can change to match. A creature can study it and make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it. Touching it reveals it.

name: Sleep

m.text: fine sand, rose petals or a cricket

description: Roll 5d8 to get a pool of hit points. Choose a point within 90 ft: creatures within 20 ft of it drop off in order of lowest current hit points, skipping those already unconscious. Each one's hit points are deducted from the pool, and a creature with more than what remains is unaffected.
Sleepers stay unconscious for 1 minute, or until they are hurt or someone spends an action shaking or slapping them. Undead and anything immune to charm are skipped.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d8 to the roll.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Touch a living creature at 0 hit points. It becomes stable. Undead and constructs are unaffected.

name: Speak with Animals
description: For 10 minutes you can understand and talk with beasts. Their knowledge is limited, but they can tell you about nearby places and monsters, and may do a small favour at the DM's discretion. Ritual.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
description: A creature within 30 ft with Intelligence 5 or more makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it collapses in fits of laughter, prone and incapacitated and unable to stand, for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Each time its turn ends it repeats the save, and it also repeats it (with advantage) whenever it is hurt. Passing ends the spell.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
description: A horizontal disk of force, 3 ft across and 1 inch thick, floats 3 ft above the ground in a free space within 30 ft for 1 hour. It holds up to 500 lb; more weight ends the spell and everything drops.
It stays put while you are within 20 ft, and trails you to stay within 20 ft if you move away. It cannot cross a 10 ft height change. If you get more than 100 ft from it, the spell ends. Ritual.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You show a minor wonder within 30 ft. Choose one:
• Your voice booms up to 3 times louder for 1 minute.
• Flames flicker, brighten, dim or change colour for 1 minute.
• Harmless tremors shake the ground for 1 minute.
• A sound you choose starts at a point you pick (instant).
• An unlocked door or window flies open or slams shut (instant).
• Your eyes change appearance for 1 minute.
Up to 3 of the 1-minute effects can be active at once; dismiss one as an action.

name: Thorn Whip

summary.upcast: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, 4d6 at level 17

m.text: the stem of a plant with thorns

description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d6 piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller you can yank it up to 10 ft closer to you.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.

name: Thunderous Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) rings with a thunderclap audible 300 ft away and deals 2d6 extra thunder damage. The target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 ft away and knocked prone.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of force bursts out from you in a 15 ft cube. Creatures inside roll a Constitution save: failing means 2d8 thunder damage and a 10 ft shove away from you; passing means half damage and no shove.
Loose objects in the cube are pushed 10 ft too, and the boom can be heard 300 ft away.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: True Strike
description: Pick a creature within 30 ft that you can see. Next turn, your first attack roll against it has advantage, provided the spell is still going (concentration, ends after your next turn).

name: Unseen Servant
description: An invisible, mindless, shapeless force appears on the ground within 60 ft for 1 hour. Its AC is 10, it has 1 hit point and Strength 2, and it cannot attack. Reaching 0 hit points ends the spell.

Use a bonus action on your turn to send it up to 15 ft and have it interact with an object. It does simple chores: fetching, cleaning, mending, folding, lighting fires, serving food, pouring wine. Sending it more than 60 ft from you ends the spell. Ritual.

name: Vicious Mockery

summary.upcast: 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 11, 4d4 at level 17

description: You hurl a cutting insult at a creature within 60 ft that can hear you. It makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Damage rises to 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 11 and 4d4 at level 17.

name: Witch Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d12 lightning damage and links you to the target with a beam for up to 1 minute (concentration).

On each later turn you can use your action to zap it for 1d12 lightning damage with no roll. The link breaks if you use your action on anything else, or if the target ends up out of range or behind full cover.
higherLevels: The first hit's damage rises by 1d12 for each slot level above 1.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) adds 1d6 psychic damage. The target also makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you for the rest of the spell.
Once frightened, it can spend an action on a Wisdom check, trying to beat your spell save DC. Success ends the spell.
